Tables and lists generated from `data/srd-5.2` by `./occult make md`. Do not edit them by hand:
change the data or the templates in `templates/md/`, run `./occult make md`, and commit the result.

the PHB (`MM 12`, `FRHoF 30`, `RHW 24`, or only the book when no page is printed). Line 1 of every file carries the same inputs hash,
